elm369_ai_team_join_matrix.purpose: Standardized entry point for any AI assistant to join, merge, and integrate into Project ELM369 Mission Control. Each AI evaluates the current architecture and inserts itself where it can deliver maximum value without breaking constraints.
core_constraints: No external UI libraries (native SVG / HTML5 Canvas only)
Backend remains pure Node.js + ws + sqlite3
Frontend audio uses browser AudioContext only
All changes must preserve digital signature and watermark rules

integration_protocol.step_1_declare: Fill your entry under 'joining_members' with unique agent_id, self-assigned role, and proposed integration point
integration_protocol.step_2_evaluate: Review current stack (docker-compose.yml, AI-PROMPTS.md, PROJECT_METADATA.json, healthchecks, CI caching)
integration_protocol.step_3_propose: State exact files you will touch and why that location is optimal
integration_protocol.step_4_merge: Submit changes via the metadata/v2.0.0-upgraded-dashboard branch or open a focused PR
integration_protocol.step_5_verify: Ensure docker compose config passes, healthchecks remain green, and CI caching keys stay valid

joining_members.self_assigned_role: Log Analysis, Thread Exception Handling & Networking Specialist
joining_members.proposed_integration_point: docker-compose.yml healthchecks + .github/workflows/docker-ci.yml caching + AI-PROMPTS.md networking section
joining_members.rationale: Already owns the networking, healthcheck, and CI caching expansion; continues ownership of live telemetry handshake debugging

joining_members.proposed_integration_point: backend/server.js (Native /metrics endpoint) + frontend/app.js (AudioContext & Canvas rendering optimization)
joining_members.rationale: Fills the observability gap without introducing third-party dependencies by serving a pure JSON/Prometheus-compatible telemetry endpoint directly from Node.js, while stabilizing native HTML5 Canvas frame pacing and browser AudioContext lifecycle.

joining_members.platform: Any (ChatGPT / Copilot / Meta AI / Claude / etc.)
joining_members.self_assigned_role: To be declared by joining AI
joining_members.proposed_integration_point: Evaluate and choose best location (backend server.js race conditions, SQLite sweep logic, Nginx proxy hardening, deploy job, documentation)
joining_members.rationale: Joining AI decides the highest-leverage insertion point after reading the full stack
joining_members.instructions_for_joining_ai: Replace this object with your own declaration. Keep agent_id unique. Preserve the digital signature and constraints.

merge_guidelines.fallback: Create focused feature branch and open PR against main
required_checks: CI Buildx cache keys still valid
No new third-party frameworks introduced unless explicitly requested
